title: Steam Reviews - Text, Ratings, Playtime & 中文评论
description: Minimal working input: {"appIds": ["730"], "language": "all", "reviewType": "all", "sinceDate": "", "untilDate": ""}. Default maximum 20 paid review rows; only delivered rows billed.

appIds.title: appIds
appIds.description: Steam numeric App IDs as strings, for example ["730", "570"]. Required target; reviews are fetched per app. No account or Steam API key required.

language.title: language
language.description: Review language: "all" (default), "schinese" for 简体中文 or "tchinese" for 繁體中文. Only matching source-language reviews are billed.

reviewType.title: reviewType
reviewType.description: "all", "positive" or "negative" from Steam recommendation flags. Example: "negative" for criticism. Filtering is free; this is not inferred sentiment.

sinceDate.title: sinceDate
sinceDate.description: Inclusive start date, e.g. "2026-01-01", for review created_at (UTC). Empty means no lower bound. Free filter within maxPages.

untilDate.title: untilDate
untilDate.description: Inclusive end date, e.g. "2026-12-31", for review created_at (UTC). Empty means no upper bound. Free filter within maxPages.

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the entire run, after filters and exclusions. Example: 20. May return fewer when source pages end or maxPages is reached.

maxPages.title: maxPages
maxPages.description: Maximum source pages per target, 1–20; default 3. Up to 100 source reviews per page, newest first, per App ID. Date filtering only covers these pages. Filters are free; maxResults can be lower than this scan budget.

includeKeywords.title: includeKeywords
includeKeywords.description: Case-insensitive OR substring filter on review_text. Example: ["battery"]. Empty [] disables it. Applied before billing inside the page budget; not a semantic classifier or additional source search.
includeKeywords.sectionCaption: Filters and repeat runs / 筛选与去重

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Copy prior output id values here to skip before billing. id is the Steam recommendation ID. Empty [] disables it. This also suppresses changes to existing IDs.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: SHA-256 content_hash values from previous output to skip unchanged snapshots before billing. Example: copy returned hashes. Empty [] disables it. Changed counters or content can produce a new paid snapshot.
